label: Scrollable Content
description: A bottom drawer with scrolling content. Best for the default bottom panel, up to most of the screen, that a downward swipe dismisses.

label: Right Side
description: A drawer from the right side. Best for a panel docked to the right edge that a swipe to the right dismisses.

label: Left Side
description: A drawer from the left side. Best for a panel docked to the left edge, closed by a swipe toward the left.

label: Top Side
description: A drawer from the top. Best for a drawer that drops from the top edge, up to half the screen, and closes with an upward swipe.

label: All Sides
description: Drawers from every side. Best for 4 triggers, one drawer per edge, to compare the directions.
